source_text: We have a chapter on simplicial methods, see Simplicial, Section <REF_0001>. This has to be reviewed and improved. The discussion of the relationship between simplicial homotopy (also known as combinatorial homotopy) and Kan complexes should be improved upon. There is a chapter on simplicial spaces, see Simplicial Spaces, Section <REF_0002>. This chapter briefly discusses simplicial topological spaces, simplicial sites, and simplicial topoi. We can further develop <QUOTEOPEN_0001>simplicial algebraic geometry<QUOTECLOSE_0001> to discuss simplicial schemes (or simplicial algebraic spaces, or simplicial algebraic stacks) and treat geometric questions, their cohomology, etc.
